notes: §1985:VI.5.8.3 SR12: 'There must not be any entry that contains an OCCURS clause between the descriptions of the data items identified by the data-names in the KEY IS phrase and the subject of the entry.' OccursKeyResolvePass.Run resolves each KEY data-name and asks OccursKeyItemFault, which below dialect level 2002 (kb/Work PB5192) asks OccursEntryBetween, a source-order walk of the table's subtree up to the key's entry, and reports COBOL2787 for the first entry with an OCCURS clause it passes, in place of the 2023 hierarchy walk (§2023:13.18.38.3 SR4), so the prior PARTIAL's sibling-table hole is closed. Probes at --std 85 (classes a, b, c, d): refused an elementary sibling table before the key (k1), a group table before the key (k2), a table between two keys K4A and K4B (k3), the key under 10 G OCCURS 2 (k6), a table inside a non-OCCURS group before the key of an OCCURS DEPENDING ON table (k7), a REDEFINESd table before the key (k10, also COBOL1701); accepted and legal a table after the last key (k4), the subject as its own key (k5), a key inside a group before a table in an ODO table (k8), a keyed table inside an outer table (k9); k1, k2 and k3 compile at --std 2023, the narrowed rule. The witness puts the key K under 10 G OCCURS 2 TIMES and is refused COBOL2787. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5192 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-12.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-12-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985: "There must not be any entry that contains an OCCURS clause between the descriptions of the data items identified by the data-names"; 2023: "If data-name-2 is subordinate to an alphanumeric group item... that group item shall not contain an OCCURS clause.". 1985 bars any OCCURS entry placed between the subject and a KEY item, e.g. an earlier sibling table. 2023 bars OCCURS only in groups that contain data-name-2, so such a sibling is now allowed.
